settings.q: Can you build a model of our specific warehouse or facility?
settings.a: Yes. Send drawings, site plans or photos and we will build an accurate, branded scale model of your exact facility, including buildings, yard and fleet.
Yes - warm interior LED lighting is built in, and we can add switchable or remote-controlled lighting on request.

settings.q: How big is the model and can I choose the scale?
settings.a: We build to the size and scale your space allows - from a tabletop presentation model to a large exhibition centrepiece. Tell us your display area and we will advise.
Yes, we ship worldwide from Dubai, crated for safe transit.

settings.hero_desc: A fully detailed scale model of a logistics warehouse and distribution facility - offices, warehouses, loading docks, branded trucks, landscaping and warm LED-lit interiors, all to scale on a presentation base. The ideal way to showcase an entire logistics operation to clients, investors and visitors in a single, tangible centrepiece.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your facility layout, branding and size
settings.s1_body: This logistics warehouse model recreates an entire distribution facility in miniature - the warehouses and offices, the loading docks with branded trucks pulling in, the yard, roads and landscaping, all built to scale and lit from within with warm LED lighting. Built from your drawings and finished in your branding, it lets clients, investors and visitors understand your whole operation at a glance. A commanding centrepiece for receptions, boardrooms and exhibition stands.
settings.case_body: Built for GAC Logistics company to showcase their upcoming warehouse and distribution facility, this model turned a sprawling real-world site into a tangible centrepiece - used in reception and at exhibitions to walk clients through the whole operation, building by building.
settings.case_quote: Clients finally see our entire facility at a glance. The model looks gorgeous.
settings.prov_p: A logistics facility is hard to picture from a site plan or a slide. A detailed, lit scale model turns that complexity into a clear, confidence-building story - a centrepiece that keeps your operation in front of clients long after the meeting ends.
